FUNCTION SlidingWindowMaximum(arr, k):
    result <- EMPTY LIST
    deque <- EMPTY DEQUE
    // Stores indices
    
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF arr - 1 DO
        IF deque IS NOT EMPTY AND deque[0] <= i - k THEN
            REMOVE FRONT FROM deque
        END IF
        
        WHILE deque IS NOT EMPTY AND arr[deque[LAST]] <= arr[i] DO
            REMOVE BACK FROM deque
        END WHILE
        
        ADD BACK i TO deque
        
        IF i >= k - 1 THEN
            APPEND arr[deque[0]] TO result
        END IF
    END FOR
    
    RETURN result
END FUNCTION

            CALL deque_pop_front(deque)
        ENDIF
